gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-005 identifies that the reflected cross-kernel construction is not automatically a valid symmetric PSD Gram matrix and supplies the missing invariance premise and feature-map PSD repair. This directly covers why unqualified m2 substitution cannot inherit the solver and convergence claims.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify the unsupported use of the m2 reflected matrix as a symmetric PSD kernel/Gram matrix without conditions ensuring symmetry and positive semidefiniteness, invalidating unrestricted solver and convergence applicability.

component_coverage.gold_component: The unqualified two-term m2 substitution may produce a matrix that is not a valid symmetric PSD kernel Gram matrix, so the inherited solver formulas and convergence guarantee require an explicit reflection-compatibility premise.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly diagnoses the cross-kernel/PSD premise as false, notes that Ω_s can fail to be symmetric without invariance, and gives the required invariance and feature-map projection repair.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 directly identifies the nonexistent target of “continue outer loop,” the undefined post-unshrinking control flow, the failure to distinguish budget exhaustion from convergence, and the resulting lack of certification, with the corresponding loop and reconstruction repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify that alg:smo has no defined bounded restart path after full-set reconstruction detects a violation, so it may return without certification or cannot complete the required unshrinking cycle.

component_coverage.gold_component: After the for-loop exits, the instruction to continue an outer loop has no target, so active-set reset and full-set reconstruction cannot reliably restart optimization.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states that the only loop has exited, the continue target is absent, and control flow after unshrinking is undefined.

component_coverage.gold_component: The procedure can fail to meet its certification/output contract when a frozen-variable violation is found or the iteration budget is exhausted.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction identifies uncertified returns and unbounded or ambiguous looping, and prescribes a bounded outer loop, full-set recomputation, and explicit non-convergence reporting.
